payload.title: Split the review-rate program and held-out evaluation out of embedded_cyclotron.py
payload.description:
src/decision_flywheel/embedded_cyclotron.py is 1,900 lines and flywheel.py is 887. Cyclotron owns decisions, review selection, the review-rate program, usage pricing, held-out evaluation, snapshot and restore, priming additions, learning passes and lock lending.
Do, as separate commits so each is reviewable: (1) move the review-rate program state, _select, _advance_program, set_review_rate, clear_review_rate and _review_rate_status into a ReviewRateController in review_program.py or a new module, with Cyclotron delegating; (2) move freeze_held_out_set, held_out_sets, held_out_reports, held_out_request_bound, _held_out_set, _active_audit_reviews and evaluate_held_out into held_out_evaluation.py with a thin Cyclotron facade so the public API does not change; (3) store held-out sets one row (or one document key) per set instead of one JSON blob per classifier in meta (embedded_cyclotron.py:1296, :1316, :1430), in both adapters; (4) move usage pricing into run_usage.py if it is not already the home. Keep every public method name. No behaviour change: the existing specs must pass unchanged, then move specs beside their new modules.
Done when: embedded_cyclotron.py is under about 1,000 lines, all specs pass unchanged, the public Cyclotron API is byte-for-byte the same. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
